content:
Overview

Matera is a city in Basilicata with a population of 60,000. A UNESCO World Heritage city famous for its ancient Sassi cave dwellings, a European Capital of Culture with an otherworldly landscape. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6a growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. Reported crime rates are relatively low. The population skews older, with a median age of 47.0.
